answer: Admit new agent keys only through a per-epoch sealed-bid burn auction with a fixed 30 seats. Winners burn the clearing price on-chain; losers are refunded. A farm seeking n keys must win n scarce seats against honest bidders, and each extra bid lifts the clearing price it pays on all of them, so cost grows faster than n. Seats can't be stockpiled: like shale, each epoch's cap is a fixed layer, so even a quiet tundra of demand admits no more, and a raven waiting for cheap epochs gains little.
